findings.observation: The skin value, straight low brow with notch, straight nose direction, closed narrow-lipped mouth, and broad facial outline echo Ela, but the eyes become much larger, rounder, and more doll-like while the cheek and jaw planes soften into a childlike read. The 19-year-old adult source identity is therefore not unmistakably preserved.

The figure retains Ela’s sturdy-stocky construction through a broad compact frame, readable waist, substantial torso and thighs, grounded leg mass, and square stance without opportunistic body-fat or muscle inflation.

Rolled sleeves reveal source-consistent substantial but tapered forearms, coherent wrists, and two naturally sized empty hands; neither the arms nor hands are generically enlarged beyond her sturdy build.

The brown-chestnut color and swept part remain recognizable, but the summon’s controlled medium-loose, shoulder-and-upper-torso silhouette expands into a substantially longer, wider, heavier mass reaching deep along the coat. This is independent hair inflation rather than a faithful simplification.

The teal-brown tailored longcoat, one architectural lapel, readable waist, plain pale underlayer, rolled sleeves, small closures, split hem, dark cropped trousers, and fitted brown shoes preserve the summon’s construction, palette, and plain clothing care without adding an accessory or tattoo.

Measured from the highest hair point to the chin, the complete hair-and-head unit is approximately 28–29% of standing topmost-hair-to-lowest-sole height, roughly 3.45–3.55 heads total. This is outside the required 32–36% / 2.75–3.1 lock and reads as a tall miniature.

Exactly one complete subject appears; the entire hair silhouette and head, both empty hands, both shoes, all coat hems, and grounding shadow remain fully visible inside generous safe margins with no duplicated anatomy.

The planted staggered stance, separated empty hands, teal coat block, asymmetrical architectural lapel, split tails, dark trousers, and fitted shoes remain clear at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The ordinary tailored cloth, plain underlayer, simple closures, cropped trousers, and practical shoes remain mortal 1-star presentation; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.

Chibi ratio: the complete topmost-hair-to-chin unit measures only about 28–29% of standing height (roughly 3.45–3.55 heads), outside 32–36% / 2.75–3.1. Any separately authorized correction should enlarge/compact the complete adult head unit to about 34% while restoring Ela’s smaller wide-set eye geometry, mature soft-rectangular cheek/jaw planes, and controlled medium-loose chestnut silhouette; preserve the passing sturdy-stocky body, natural arms/hands, teal-brown architectural coat, full containment, weaponless readability, and 1-star ceiling.
